i.norm: Verifies that merging a Value with itself returns the same instance unchanged. When both base and override are identical (same object), withOverrides() short-circuits via the _equals() check and returns `this`. The resulting Value retains ignoreUnknown=true and the default allowGetters=false, allowSetters=false, merge=true settings.
